paper.title: Online Influence Maximization under Independent Cascade Model with Semi-Bandit Feedback

settings.name_in_paper: Independent cascade semi-bandit (ICSB) with linear generalization
unmapped: Actions are seed sets of K nodes in a known directed graph with L nodes and |E| edges; reward is the number of nodes influenced under the independent cascade model (submodular, nonlinear reward in edge weights)
Edge-level semi-bandit feedback: edge activations observed only for edges whose start node is influenced (probabilistically triggered arms)
Edge activation probabilities are linear in known edge features: w(e) = x_e^T theta*, ||x_e||_2 <= 1
Offline maximization via an (alpha, gamma)-approximation oracle; regret is scaled by alpha*gamma
The paper's K (seed set cardinality) is the combinatorial action size, not number of arms
settings.definition_quote: The independent cascade semi-bandit (ICSB) problem is also characterized by a triple (G, K, w-bar), but w-bar is unknown to the agent. ... for any edge e=(u_1,u_2), the agent observes the realization of w_t(e) if and only if the start node u_1 of the directed edge e is influenced in the realization w_t.
